patches.title: Countertop First Then Containers
patches.principle: Search all countertops thoroughly before opening any cabinets or drawers.
patches.when_to_apply: When the target object is not immediately visible on open surfaces.

patches.title: No Inventory After Pickup
patches.principle: Do not use inventory or look actions after picking up the target object until it is placed.
patches.when_to_apply: After picking up an object that needs to be cleaned and placed.

patches.title: Complete Clean Sequence In One Go
patches.principle: Once you pick up the object, go directly to sink, clean it, then directly to destination and place it without interruption.
patches.when_to_apply: When handling an object that requires cleaning before placement.
